# 3d-soft-emboss

<!-- Generated by `iig3d.py docs` from catalogue/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Member of the 3D corporate family. Neumorphic soft-embossed grey devices: jigsaw ring, segment ring, overlapping circles, chevron row, hexagon clusters, pill and card lists, ring chains, hub spokes, all pressed into a matte grey field. Backdrop: Matte light grey. Items: 3 to 6. Default aspect: landscape.

## Colour palette

- Monochrome: field and shapes #E6E8EB, highlight shadow white at 80 percent, low shadow #B9BEC5, icons and text #4A4F57
- A brand colour override tints only the icons and item names; shapes stay grey

## Visual elements

- Ring device 55 to 70 percent of the canvas height, edge shadows 3 to 5 percent of its diameter
- Grooves between pieces as thin dark-then-light shadow pairs
- Icon discs raised, 14 to 18 percent of the device diameter, flat dark icons
- Text cards raised the same way, aligned in one column
- Matte finish everywhere; no gloss highlights

## Typography

- Family typography; numerals thin and large in light grey, names bold caps dark grey, body light grey

## Composition rules

- Landscape: device right, cards left (ref 01) or device centred with items either side (ref 02)
- Three items: segment ring or overlapping circles; four items: jigsaw or segment ring
- {'Five or six items': 'chevron row, landscape only'}
- More than six items, switch to 3d-paper-tile or 3d-capsule-hub
- Six items: hex cluster or tile grid; five items: ring chain or hex arc hub
- Portrait or square sources: pill list, framed pill list or bar stack

## Layout

### Structure

- One ring device 55 to 70 percent of the canvas height, on the right or centred
- Jigsaw ring: a disc cut into three or four puzzle pieces with knob-and-socket edges, one icon disc per piece
- Segment ring: a disc cut into three or four wedges by thin grooves, one icon disc per wedge
- Overlapping circles: three translucent circles overlapping like a Venn, numerals in the overlaps, icon disc on each outer lobe
- Numbered text cards or big numerals in a column beside the device, one per item
- {'Chevron row': 'five or six raised chevron arrows nesting left to right in one row, numeral and name on each, a raised icon disc with a caption under each chevron'}
- Hexagon devices: raised hexagons in columns or an arc, connected to a centre disc by thin lines with end dots
- List devices: raised icon discs or numeral tiles beside rounded pill or card text blocks, in one or two columns
- Hub devices: one large centre disc with spokes or brackets to raised icon discs, text beside each
- Paired cards: two columns of six raised cards, each row joined by a short connector with end dots, a numeral tile and an icon tile at the head of every card

### Variants

| Variant | Focus | Visual Emphasis |
|---------|-------|-----------------|
| **Jigsaw ring** | Parts that lock into one whole | Puzzle-cut disc, pieces separated by fine grooves |
| **Segment ring** | Cycles and phases | Wedge-cut disc around a recessed centre |
| **Overlapping circles** | Shared ground between three areas | Three raised circles with numerals in the overlaps |
| **Chevron row** | Sequences of five or six steps | Raised chevrons in a row with one rolled glossy edge each and flat gaps between, icon discs and captions beneath, title between thin rules |
| **Hex cluster** | Six capabilities around one core | Two columns of three raised hexagons flanking a central ring disc, thin connectors with end dots |
| **Tile grid** | Six numbered points at a glance | Numeral hexagon tile beside a rounded text card, two columns of three |
| **Pill list** | Three to four points read top to bottom | Raised icon discs in a column with a rounded pill card beside each, optionally inside one large raised panel |
| **Numbered cards** | Three ordered points with equal weight | Rounded cards each carrying a large numeral, name and detail, in a row or a column, icon disc optional |
| **Ring chain** | Five linked stages | Raised ring nodes joined by one zigzag band, icon in each ring, labels alternating above and below |
| **Capsule row** | Four parallel pillars | Tall capsules in a row, white icon disc at the top of each, name and detail inside |
| **Hex arc hub** | Five satellites around one centre | Hexagon tiles in an arc left of a large centre disc, dotted connectors and small ring nodes |
| **Bar stack** | Three stages with icon and numeral | Stacked rounded bars, each with a raised icon sphere and a numeral ring, sides alternating |
| **Step branches** | Three steps from one centre | Large centre disc left, step rings on a vertical stem, each with a header tab and a text bar |
| **Arrow bars** | Four ranked measures | Half disc left, arrow bars stacked with name and numeral, icon ring and percentage to the right |
| **Hub spokes** | Three pillars from one hub | Centre disc or title with straight or bracket connectors to a column of raised icon discs, text beside each |
| **Lettered discs** | Four lettered options | Raised discs with big letters resting on U cradles, stems down to text blocks |
| **Paired cards** | Six problems each matched to one answer | Two columns of raised cards joined row by row by a short connector, numeral tile and icon tile at the head of each card |

### Visual Elements

- Every shape is the same light grey as the backdrop, raised by a soft light-top-left shadow and a darker bottom-right shadow
- Icon discs raised a second level above the piece, dark grey flat icons
- Recessed centre disc on the ring devices
- Text cards: raised rounded rectangles with a large light-grey numeral and dark text
- No colour, no outlines, no gloss; depth comes from shadow only

### Text Placement

- Title centred at top between two thin rules
- Item numerals 01 to 04 large and light grey on the cards or beside the device
- Item name bold caps in dark grey, description light grey below
- No text on the device except numerals in the overlaps
